evidence_scope: Recorded local test result; separate public playback validation accompanies publication.

families.name: Gait phase, starts/stops and pivots
families.work: Both: metadata/controller first, then targeted motion variants.
families.test: Walk to jog to sprint to stop, on both lead feet; turn 90 degrees and reverse 180 degrees without foot snaps. Current motion() resets phase when changing clips.

families.name: Sustained combat-ready posture
families.status: Game loops missing; earlier guard sources exist
missing: Guard walk and strafe in eight directions
families.work: Reuse earlier Fight guard/footwork takes before new generation; derive proper loops and add state/interrupt rules.
families.test: Hold focus for 10 seconds, circle and backpedal, attack and return to guard without dropping into relaxed idle.

families.name: Real target-facing locomotion
families.status: Ordinary strafe clips exist; target system missing
missing: Actor-local direction selection around a target
families.work: Controller and camera first. Existing directional loops can seed the test.
families.test: Circle a moving target clockwise/counterclockwise and retreat while facing it. A focus camera-heading strafe is not target lock.

families.name: Short dodge versus long roll
families.status: Short directional bursts wired; long roll set missing
families.work: Active source windows and a 0.32-second displacement curve now drive interruptible evades. Assess their visual quality before adding directional rolls.
families.test: Evade in each direction, then immediately move, C, punch or Space. Confirm cancellation without a second Alt press and solid-wall collision.

families.name: Reusable airborne / fall / landing states
families.status: Jump/fall and high-drop superhero contact layer wired; fall pose library partial
families.work: Segment/tag existing jumps first; generate only missing recovery/fall variants.
families.test: Jump at different approach speeds and off a ledge, land early/late, then continue in the held direction without replaying an entire jump.

families.name: Responsive stance transitions
families.status: Immediate crouch and double-C seiza wired; support variants partial
missing: Headroom checks across every stance exit, including prone
families.work: Trim and tag transition windows, then controller rules; contact retakes only where needed.
families.test: C immediately selects crouch locomotion; C C holds seiza; Space preempts either. Standing and jump exits must reject a low ceiling. Assess the short pose blend and support contacts visually.

families.name: Carrying under real interaction conditions
families.status: Baseline present; support and variants partial
families.work: Both. Fix grip/contact rules and prop parenting before requesting many more clips.
families.test: Lift, rotate, carry diagonally, stop, put down on a marked surface and interrupt safely. Record props separately: current character GLB recording excludes them.

families.name: Action timing, buffering and safe context
families.status: Immediate replacement / repeat attack wired; deeper context rules partial
missing: Short bounded input buffer around actual landing
Combat-specific commitment rules and damage events
View / occlusion scoring for E objects
families.test: Alt to Space, crouch to Space, repeated LMB, punch to Space and cold-load cancellation must keep the latest input. Pickup/putdown cancellation must preserve the actual attachment event.

families.name: Weapon aim, draw and reload
families.work: Requires weapon props, attachment rig and animation layers as well as clips.
families.test: Aim over either shoulder, move and reload while feet continue their gait. Do not claim an RMB focus mode supplies these animations.

families.name: Cover and contextual traversal
families.status: Low vault/mantle and high ledge-grab/pull-up wired; contact quality needs review
missing: Ladder mount / idle / up / down / dismount
families.work: Explicit range/height/landing checks; high ledges add jump/catch/hang/pull-up/top-out with hand locks. Authored contact layers over generated sources, not a learned physical climbing policy. Ladders and cover remain open.
families.test: Same action at several real obstacle heights with hands and feet staying attached. A text-prompt vault is not validated contact traversal.

families.name: Directional reactions and ground recovery
families.work: Repair existing body/floor contacts before multiplying variants.
families.test: Both robots recover without armour, head or hands passing through floor or seats. Raw ground intersections remain measured in this kit.

families.name: Remapping and readable input feedback
families.work: Input/UI work. Requires no new mocap.
families.test: Navigate controls with keyboard, remap E, reload and export settings, and verify prompts/menus preserve the same action semantics.

families.name: Genre-specific expansion
families.work: New gameplay, props and motions; not baseline locomotion requirements.
families.test: Add only after the level and game design need that mechanic; do not copy every feature from all five games into one controller.

result.scope: Static inventory/code audit. Existing candidate IDs do not establish accepted motion quality or completed game states.
